what.text: This page follows refugees from Lebanon living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3128 Lebanese refugees in Germany, 32.7% of all refugees from Lebanon.
Germany is the largest host of Lebanese refugees, followed by Canada, Denmark and France.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Lebanon in these years: with the Islamic State group in 2014, 2015 and 2017.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2008 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 19035 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
